p242-cover.text: Widescreen hand-painted key art. Original Ma Nan design for buzz cut, charcoal hood and A emblem; authentic ark for blue clouds, ice-stone timber hull, orange solar hearth. Ma Nan and ginger Latte on deck foreground; huge frost whale arcs past the warm ark. Leave upper-left sky clear for Chinese lettering added by the preview page. No baked letters, frame or watermarks.
